title: Celebrity Trivia
description: Test your knowledge of famous celebrities, from Hollywood icons to music legends and beyond.

questions.prompt: Which actor won the Academy Award for Best Actor in 2022?
questions.explanation: Will Smith won the Oscar for Best Actor at the 2022 Academy Awards for his role in 'King Richard'.

questions.prompt: In which country was Taylor Swift born?
questions.explanation: Taylor Swift was born in Reading, Pennsylvania, United States on December 13, 1989.

questions.prompt: Which celebrity is married to Hailey Baldwin?
questions.explanation: Justin Bieber married model Hailey Baldwin in September 2018. They have been together since 2015.

questions.prompt: What is Oprah Winfrey's real first name?
questions.explanation: Oprah Winfrey's birth name is Orpah Gail Winfrey, but she is known as Oprah to the world.

questions.prompt: Which actor starred as Tony Stark in the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
questions.explanation: Robert Downey Jr. played Tony Stark/Iron Man throughout the Marvel Cinematic Universe films.

questions.prompt: How many Grammy Awards did Beyoncé win at the 2023 Grammy Awards?
questions.explanation: Beyoncé won 7 Grammy Awards at the 2023 Grammy Awards, breaking records with her wins.

questions.prompt: Which musician is known as the 'King of Pop'?
questions.explanation: Michael Jackson earned the title 'King of Pop' for his revolutionary music and influence on popular culture.

questions.prompt: What is the real name of the rapper Eminem?
questions.explanation: Eminem's real name is Marshall Mathers. He adopted the stage name based on his initials (M&M).

questions.prompt: Which actress won the Academy Award for Best Actress in 2021?
questions.explanation: Frances McDormand won the Oscar for Best Actress at the 2021 Academy Awards for her role in 'Nomadland'.

questions.prompt: How many children does Angelina Jolie have?
questions.explanation: Angelina Jolie has 6 children, whom she shares with Brad Pitt and some whom she adopted internationally.

questions.prompt: What is the stage name of Marshall Bruce Mathers III?
questions.explanation: Marshall Bruce Mathers III goes by the stage name Eminem, one of the best-selling artists of all time.

questions.prompt: Which actor directed and starred in 'Dune: Part One' (2021)?
questions.explanation: Denis Villeneuve directed 'Dune: Part One', though Timothée Chalamet starred as the protagonist Paul Atreides.

questions.prompt: In what year did Meghan Markle marry Prince Harry?
questions.explanation: Meghan Markle married Prince Harry on May 19, 2018 at St. George's Chapel in Windsor Castle.

questions.prompt: Which actor is known for playing Batman in the 2022 film 'The Batman'?
questions.explanation: Robert Pattinson starred as Batman/Bruce Wayne in the 2022 film directed by Matt Reeves.

questions.prompt: How many Academy Awards has Meryl Streep been nominated for?
questions.explanation: Meryl Streep has received 21 Academy Award nominations, more than any other actor in history, and has won 3 Oscars.
